title: kbmon --status host and the host panel's data show a disk share just under 10% as 10%, where the host alert says 9.96%
goal: mon_host.disk keeps a free share just under 10% below 10% (two decimals, as the alert shows it), so kbmon.py --status never prints 10% for a disk under the low-disk threshold

run: import sys, collections, shutil; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import mon_host; U = collections.namedtuple("U", "total used free"); shutil.disk_usage = lambda p: U(100000, 90040, 9960); d = mon_host.disk("."); print(d); sys.exit(0 if d["free_pct"] < 10 else 1)
